children: Stock-specific activity is likely to remain in focus on Dalal Street on September 1, following a slew of corporate developments, block deals and earnings.

Milky Mist Dairy Food share price rose 6% on reported a 10-fold jump in consolidated profit to Rs 64.7 crore in Q1, compared with Rs 6.5 crore in the year-ago period. Consolidated revenue also surged 43.6% YoY to Rs 973.4 crore, from Rs 678.1 crore, reflecting strong growth during the quarter.
EPL share price fell 6 percent after 24.5 lakh shares of the company changed hands in two block deals.

Shares of LEAP India fell 4% despite company reported a 30.3% YoY increase in consolidated profit to Rs 24.7 crore in Q1, compared with Rs 19 crore in the year-ago period. Consolidated revenue also grew 19.1% YoY to Rs 203.4 crore, from Rs 170.8 crore, supported by healthy business growth.

Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri shares added 20% after GRT Jewellers India signed a share purchase agreement with the promoters of Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri (TBZ) to acquire their 74.12 percent stake in TBZ for up to Rs 1,033.71 crore. GRT Jewellers will also launch an open offer for an additional stake of around 26 percent.

Happiest Minds share price slipped 6% after promoters Ashok Soota and Ashok Soota Medical Research LLP have entered into a share purchase agreement with ITC Infotech for the sale of 3.36 crore equity shares, representing a 22.106 percent stake in Happiest Minds Technologies, for Rs 1,329.7 crore. Also the board approved the amalgamation of Happiest Minds Technologies with ITC Infotech. As part of the merger, ITC Infotech will issue 25 equity shares to Happiest Minds shareholders for every 81 shares held in Happiest Minds.

Investors are expected to remain focused on brokerage calls, block deals, order wins, regulatory developments and other company-specific triggers that could drive stock-level volatility during the session.

title: Buzzing Stocks: Milky Mist shares gain 6% on strong earnings; TBZ surges 20% on GRT stake buy
